author: Filmento
description:
Bright is a Will Smith Netflix police movie where Lord of the Rings is the norm in modern day. The idea is great but the execution not so much, since the movie was universally disliked by everyone. So today, let's find out how the hell that happened. How great movie ideas go wrong.
